class.name: StyleBoxFlatMerged
class.brief_description: A [StyleBox] that combines two [StyleBoxFlat]s into a single one.
class.description: One of the [StyleBoxFlat]s will be set as primary, its values will be prioritzed. The values set to default will be overriden by those in the second [StyleBoxFlat]. In case one [StyleBoxFlat] is not set, the other one will take priority even on values left to default. If none are set the values will be set to mostly useless and arbitrary defaults.

members.member: The primary [StyleBoxFlat] - Its properties will be prioritzed unless they're set to their default values.
